title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service by exploiting improper validation of user-influenced resource identifiers. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability.
